## Specification

### Component: TagInput

A field that turns text into removable chips. Looks like the Input; value is `string[]`.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-tag-input [ui-tag-input-sm|lg]" data-disabled data-readonly>
  <span class="ui-badge ui-badge-secondary ui-tag" data-tag-value="design" data-highlighted data-shake>
    <span class="ui-tag-label">design</span>
    <button type="button" tabindex="-1" class="ui-badge-remove" aria-label="Remove design">× icon</button>
  </span>
  <input type="text" class="ui-tag-input-field">                      role="combobox" when suggestions exist
  <div class="ui-floating ui-tag-listbox" popover="manual" role="listbox" data-state>   FloatingContent, matchWidth, bottom-start
    <div class="ui-tag-option" role="option" aria-selected data-highlighted>…</div>
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" name>                                          joined by `separator`
  <span class="ui-tag-input-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">  visually hidden messages
</div>
```
Chips are the secondary `Badge` (size = the field size) with `BadgeRemove`.

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` (`string[]`), `onValueChange(tags)` via `useControllableState`.
- `maxTags`, `validate(tag, tags) → true | false | message`, `onTagRejected(tag, reason, message?)` (`duplicate | max | invalid`), `suggestions`, `delimiters` (default `[","]`), `allowDuplicates`, `caseSensitive` (both false), `addOnBlur` (true), `name`, `separator` (","), `size` `sm|md|lg`, `removeLabel(tag)`, `groupClassName`. Native input props go to the text input; `ref` is the text input. Inside a Field: `useFieldControl` on the text input.
- Pure helpers (`tag-utils.ts`): `splitTags`, `addTags`, `sameTag`.

#### Behaviour
- Enter, Tab (without Shift) or a typed delimiter adds the trimmed text (Enter/Tab only when there is text; with suggestions open and one highlighted, that suggestion is added). A delimiter typed or inserted anywhere in the text commits everything before it and keeps the remainder (works with mobile keyboards). Tab and Enter `preventDefault` only when they added or tried to add.
- Paste containing a comma, a delimiter or a line break is split (`splitTags`) and added at once.
- Rejections: a duplicate (case-insensitive unless `caseSensitive`) shakes the existing chip (`data-shake`, 360ms, restartable) and keeps the typed text; `max` and `validate` refusals keep the text too. Each refusal calls `onTagRejected` and puts a message in the live region ("ada is already added", "Limit of 5 tags reached", or the validate message).
- Backspace on empty text: first press sets `data-highlighted` on the last chip, second removes it. Any other key, typing or blur clears the highlight.
- The × removes that chip and returns focus to the text input. Clicking empty space in the box focuses the input. Blur adds leftover text when `addOnBlur`.
- Suggestions: up to 8, filtered by text, hiding tags already added. Open on typing or ArrowDown (highlights the first); ArrowUp/Down wrap; Escape closes (and stops propagation so a surrounding dialog stays open); the list `mousedown` is `preventDefault` so the input keeps focus; pointer move highlights; click picks.
- `readOnly` hides the × buttons; `disabled` dims the box and blocks input.

#### Visual rules
- Box: same border (`--ui-border-strong`), background, radius, shadow, hover and focus ring as `.ui-input`, drawn on the box with `:focus-within`; invalid via `:has(.ui-tag-input-field[aria-invalid="true"])` → `--ui-destructive`. Min height `--ui-input-h` (32 / 36 / 44px); padding-block `(h − 2px − chip height) / 2`; gap 4px; wraps.
- Chip height 20 / 24 / 28px. A chip's label truncates with an ellipsis. Highlighted chip: `--ui-accent` bg + 2px ring at 60%.
- Text field: borderless, transparent, flex `1 1 6rem`, min width 6rem, height = chip height; placeholder only while there are no chips.
- Listbox: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, radius lg, `--ui-shadow-lg`, padding 4px, max height 14rem. Option: padding 6px 10px, radius sm, highlighted `--ui-accent`.
- Touch: 16px text.

#### Motion
- New chip `ui-pop-in` (220ms, `--ui-ease-out`); shake: translateX −4, 4, −3, 2, 0 with a destructive ring fading out over 360ms. Listbox `ui-pop-in` / `ui-pop-out`. Reduced motion keeps messages, drops movement.

#### Accessibility
- Native text input in the box; chip × buttons labelled "Remove {tag}" and out of the tab order (Backspace is the keyboard path). Live region announces added / removed / refused.
- Suggestions: `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` (only while open), `aria-activedescendant`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Enter, comma and Tab each add a chip; a pasted "a@x.com, b@x.com" adds two.
- Adding an existing tag adds nothing and the chip gets `data-shake`.
- With `maxTags`, further tags are refused.
- Backspace twice removes the last chip; × removes the clicked chip.
- The hidden input holds the joined value.
- With suggestions: typing filters, ArrowDown + Enter adds, Escape closes.
- Single row height 32 / 36 / 44px. No axe violations in light and dark.

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged. Files of the components it uses are in their own docs (see Instructions).

```ts
export { addTags, splitTags, type AddTagsOptions, type TagRejectReason, type TagRejection } from './tag-utils';
```

### `ui/components/tag-input/tag-input.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type ClipboardEvent,
  type FocusEvent,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Badge } from '../badge/badge';
import { BadgeRemove } from '../badge/badge-remove';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import type { InputSize } from '../input/input';
import { FloatingContent } from '../popover/floating-content';
import { DEFAULT_DELIMITERS, addTags, sameTag, splitTags, type TagRejectReason } from './tag-utils';

export interface TagInputProps
  extends Omit<
    InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
    'size' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'type' | 'role' | 'name'
  > {
  /** Controlled tags. */
  value?: string[];
  /** Initial tags when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string[];
  onValueChange?: (tags: string[]) => void;
  /** Most tags allowed. Further ones are rejected. */
  maxTags?: number;
  /** Return true to accept a tag; false or a message string to reject it. */
  validate?: (tag: string, tags: string[]) => boolean | string | void;
  /** Called when a tag is refused: a duplicate, over the limit, or failing `validate`. */
  onTagRejected?: (tag: string, reason: TagRejectReason, message?: string) => void;
  /** Suggestions shown in a list under the field while typing (or on ArrowDown). */
  suggestions?: string[];
  /** Characters that end a tag when typed, besides Enter and Tab. Default `[","]`. */
  delimiters?: string[];
  /** Allow the same tag twice. Default false. */
  allowDuplicates?: boolean;
  /** Treat "Design" and "design" as different tags. Default false. */
  caseSensitive?: boolean;
  /** Turn the text left in the field into a tag when it loses focus. Default true. */
  addOnBlur?: boolean;
  /** Name for the hidden input that submits the tags joined by `separator`. */
  name?: string;
  /** Joins the tags in the hidden input. Default ",". */
  separator?: string;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px minimum. Default `md`. */
  size?: InputSize;
  /** Accessible name of a chip's × button. Default "Remove {tag}". */
  removeLabel?: (tag: string) => string;
  /** Class for the surrounding box. `className` goes on the text input. */
  groupClassName?: string;
}

const MODIFIER_KEYS = ['Shift', 'Control', 'Alt', 'Meta', 'CapsLock'];

/**
 * TagInput — a field that turns text into chips. Enter, Tab or a comma adds, a paste is split
 * on commas and new lines, Backspace on empty text highlights and then removes the last chip.
 * Inside a <Field> it picks up the id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required and disabled state.
 */
export const TagInput = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, TagInputProps>(function TagInput(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    maxTags,
    validate,
    onTagRejected,
    suggestions,
    delimiters = DEFAULT_DELIMITERS,
    allowDuplicates = false,
    caseSensitive = false,
    addOnBlur = true,
    name,
    separator = ',',
    size = 'md',
    removeLabel = (tag) => `Remove ${tag}`,
    groupClassName,
    className,
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    readOnly,
    placeholder,
    onKeyDown,
    onPaste,
    onBlur,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const control = useFieldControl({
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'],
    'aria-invalid': props['aria-invalid'],
  });
  const [tags, setTags] = useControllableState<string[]>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? [],
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [highlight, setHighlight] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(-1);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, inputRef);
  const tagsRef = useRef(tags);
  tagsRef.current = tags;
  const listId = useId();

  const isDisabled = !!control.disabled;
  const locked = isDisabled || !!readOnly;
  const hasSuggestions = !!suggestions && suggestions.length > 0;

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!suggestions) return [];
    const q = text.trim().toLowerCase();
    return suggestions
      .filter((s) => allowDuplicates || !tags.some((t) => sameTag(t, s, caseSensitive)))
      .filter((s) => !q || s.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .slice(0, 8);
  }, [suggestions, text, tags, allowDuplicates, caseSensitive]);

  const open = hasSuggestions && menuOpen && filtered.length > 0 && !locked;
  const activeIndex = open && active < filtered.length ? active : -1;

  /** Restart the shake on the chip that already holds this tag. */
  const shake = (tag: string) => {
    const chips = rootRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-tag-value]');
    const chip = Array.from(chips ?? []).find((el) => sameTag(el.dataset.tagValue ?? '', tag, caseSensitive));
    if (!chip) return;
    chip.removeAttribute('data-shake');
    void chip.offsetWidth;
    chip.setAttribute('data-shake', '');
    window.setTimeout(() => chip.removeAttribute('data-shake'), 450);
  };

  const commit = (candidates: string[]) => {
    const result = addTags(tagsRef.current, candidates, { maxTags, allowDuplicates, caseSensitive, validate });
    if (result.added.length) {
      tagsRef.current = result.tags;
      setTags(result.tags);
    }
    for (const r of result.rejected) {
      if (r.reason === 'duplicate') shake(r.tag);
      onTagRejected?.(r.tag, r.reason, r.message);
    }
    const first = result.rejected[0];
    if (first) {
      setStatus(
        first.reason === 'duplicate'
          ? `${first.tag} is already added`
          : first.reason === 'max'
            ? `Limit of ${maxTags} tags reached`
            : (first.message ?? `${first.tag} is not valid`),
      );
    } else if (result.added.length) {
      setStatus(`Added ${result.added.join(', ')}`);
    }
    return result;
  };

  const removeAt = (index: number) => {
    const tag = tagsRef.current[index];
    if (tag === undefined || locked) return;
    const next = tagsRef.current.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    tagsRef.current = next;
    setTags(next);
    setStatus(`Removed ${tag}`);
    // Safari and Firefox don't focus a button on click; keep typing where it was
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const closeMenu = () => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    setActive(-1);
  };

  const pick = (suggestion: string) => {
    commit([suggestion]);
    setText('');
    closeMenu();
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  /** Enter / Tab: take the highlighted suggestion or the typed text. Returns true when it handled the key. */
  const acceptCurrent = (): boolean => {
    if (activeIndex >= 0) {
      pick(filtered[activeIndex]!);
      return true;
    }
    if (!text.trim()) return false;
    const result = commit([text]);
    if (result.added.length) setText('');
    closeMenu();
    return true;
  };

  const handleChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const next = e.target.value;
    setHighlight(false);
    if (delimiters.some((d) => d && next.includes(d))) {
      // A delimiter typed (or inserted by a mobile keyboard): everything before it becomes a tag
      let normalized = next;
      for (const d of delimiters) if (d) normalized = normalized.split(d).join('\n');
      const parts = normalized.split('\n');
      const rest = parts.pop() ?? '';
      commit(parts);
      setText(rest.trimStart());
    } else {
      setText(next);
    }
    if (hasSuggestions) {
      setMenuOpen(true);
      setActive(-1);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || locked) return;
    if (highlight && e.key !== 'Backspace' && !MODIFIER_KEYS.includes(e.key)) setHighlight(false);
    if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;

    switch (e.key) {
      case 'Enter':
        if (acceptCurrent()) e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case 'Tab':
        if (!e.shiftKey && acceptCurrent()) e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case 'Backspace': {
        const count = tagsRef.current.length;
        if (text !== '' || count === 0) break;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (highlight) {
          removeAt(count - 1);
          setHighlight(false);
        } else {
          setHighlight(true);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'ArrowDown':
        if (!hasSuggestions) break;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!open) {
          setMenuOpen(true);
          setActive(0);
        } else {
          setActive((activeIndex + 1) % filtered.length);
        }
        break;
      case 'ArrowUp':
        if (!open) break;
        e.preventDefault();
        setActive(activeIndex <= 0 ? filtered.length - 1 : activeIndex - 1);
        break;
      case 'Escape':
        if (!open) break;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        closeMenu();
        break;
    }
  };

  const handlePaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onPaste?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || locked) return;
    const pasted = e.clipboardData.getData('text');
    if (!/[\r\n]/.test(pasted) && !delimiters.some((d) => d && pasted.includes(d))) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    commit(splitTags(pasted, delimiters));
  };

  const handleBlur = (e: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onBlur?.(e);
    setHighlight(false);
    closeMenu();
    if (addOnBlur && !locked && text.trim()) {
      const result = commit([text]);
      if (result.added.length) setText('');
    }
  };

  const handleRootClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (isDisabled || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) return;
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className={cn('ui-tag-input', size !== 'md' && `ui-tag-input-${size}`, groupClassName)}
      data-disabled={isDisabled ? '' : undefined}
      data-readonly={readOnly ? '' : undefined}
      onClick={handleRootClick}
    >
      {tags.map((tag, i) => (
        <Badge
          key={allowDuplicates ? `${tag}-${i}` : tag}
          variant="secondary"
          size={size}
          className="ui-tag"
          data-tag-value={tag}
          data-highlighted={highlight && i === tags.length - 1 ? '' : undefined}
        >
          <span className="ui-tag-label">{tag}</span>
          {!readOnly && (
            <BadgeRemove aria-label={removeLabel(tag)} tabIndex={-1} disabled={isDisabled} onClick={() => removeAt(i)} />
          )}
        </Badge>
      ))}
      <input
        ref={composedRef}
        type="text"
        autoComplete="off"
        autoCapitalize="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        className={cn('ui-tag-input-field', className)}
        value={text}
        readOnly={readOnly}
        placeholder={tags.length === 0 ? placeholder : undefined}
        {...(hasSuggestions
          ? {
              role: 'combobox',
              'aria-autocomplete': 'list' as const,
              'aria-haspopup': 'listbox' as const,
              'aria-expanded': open,
              'aria-controls': open ? listId : undefined,
              'aria-activedescendant': activeIndex >= 0 ? `${listId}-${activeIndex}` : undefined,
            }
          : {})}
        {...props}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onPaste={handlePaste}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        {...control}
      />
      {hasSuggestions && (
        <FloatingContent
          open={open}
          anchorRef={rootRef}
          placement="bottom-start"
          matchWidth
          offset={4}
          id={listId}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label="Suggestions"
          className="ui-tag-listbox"
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          {filtered.map((suggestion, i) => (
            <div
              key={suggestion}
              id={`${listId}-${i}`}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={i === activeIndex}
              data-highlighted={i === activeIndex ? '' : undefined}
              className="ui-tag-option"
              onPointerMove={() => setActive(i)}
              onClick={() => pick(suggestion)}
            >
              {suggestion}
            </div>
          ))}
        </FloatingContent>
      )}
      {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={tags.join(separator)} disabled={isDisabled} />}
      <span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="ui-tag-input-status">
        {status}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/tag-input/tag-utils.ts`

```ts
export type TagRejectReason = 'duplicate' | 'max' | 'invalid';

export interface TagRejection {
  tag: string;
  reason: TagRejectReason;
  /** A message the `validate` function returned, if any. */
  message?: string;
}

export interface AddTagsOptions {
  /** Most tags allowed. */
  maxTags?: number;
  /** Allow the same tag twice. Default false. */
  allowDuplicates?: boolean;
  /** Treat "Design" and "design" as different tags. Default false. */
  caseSensitive?: boolean;
  /** Return true to accept; false or a message string to reject. */
  validate?: (tag: string, tags: string[]) => boolean | string | void;
}

export const DEFAULT_DELIMITERS = [','];

export function sameTag(a: string, b: string, caseSensitive = false): boolean {
  return caseSensitive ? a === b : a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase();
}

/** Split pasted or typed text into trimmed, non-empty tags on newlines and the given delimiters. */
export function splitTags(text: string, delimiters: string[] = DEFAULT_DELIMITERS): string[] {
  let normalized = text;
  for (const d of delimiters) if (d) normalized = normalized.split(d).join('\n');
  return normalized
    .split(/[\r\n]+/)
    .map((t) => t.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Add candidates to `current` one by one. Empty text is ignored; duplicates, tags over
 * the limit and tags `validate` refuses come back in `rejected`.
 */
export function addTags(
  current: string[],
  candidates: string[],
  { maxTags, allowDuplicates = false, caseSensitive = false, validate }: AddTagsOptions = {},
): { tags: string[]; added: string[]; rejected: TagRejection[] } {
  const tags = current.slice();
  const added: string[] = [];
  const rejected: TagRejection[] = [];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const tag = candidate.trim();
    if (!tag) continue;
    if (maxTags !== undefined && tags.length >= maxTags) {
      rejected.push({ tag, reason: 'max' });
      continue;
    }
    if (!allowDuplicates && tags.some((t) => sameTag(t, tag, caseSensitive))) {
      rejected.push({ tag, reason: 'duplicate' });
      continue;
    }
    const verdict = validate?.(tag, tags);
    if (verdict === false || typeof verdict === 'string') {
      rejected.push({ tag, reason: 'invalid', message: typeof verdict === 'string' ? verdict : undefined });
      continue;
    }
    tags.push(tag);
    added.push(tag);
  }
  return { tags, added, rejected };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/tag-input.css`

```css
/* Tag input ---------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-tag-input [ui-tag-input-sm|lg]" data-disabled data-readonly>
     <span class="ui-badge ui-badge-secondary ui-tag" data-tag-value data-highlighted data-shake>
       <span class="ui-tag-label">design</span><button class="ui-badge-remove">…</button>
     </span>
     <input class="ui-tag-input-field">
     <div class="ui-floating ui-tag-listbox" role="listbox" data-state>
       <div class="ui-tag-option" role="option" data-highlighted>…</div>
     </div>
     <span class="ui-tag-input-status">   visually hidden live region
   </div>
   Looks like .ui-input: same border, surface, ring and sizes (--ui-input-h). The box grows
   with its chips; a single row is exactly --ui-input-h tall.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-tag-input {
    --ui-input-bg: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    --ui-tag-h: 1.5rem;
    --ui-tag-pad: calc((var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem) - 2px - var(--ui-tag-h)) / 2);
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem);
    padding: var(--ui-tag-pad) calc(var(--ui-tag-pad) + 0.125rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-input-border);
    border-radius: var(--ui-input-r, var(--radius-md));
    background-color: var(--ui-input-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--ui-input-fs, var(--text-base));
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    cursor: text;
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-tag-input {
    --ui-input-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .ui-tag-input-sm { --ui-input-h: 2rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-sm); --ui-tag-h: 1.25rem; }
  .ui-tag-input-lg { --ui-input-h: 2.75rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-md); --ui-tag-h: 1.75rem; --ui-input-r: var(--radius-lg); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-tag-input:hover:not(:focus-within, [data-disabled], :has(.ui-tag-input-field[aria-invalid="true"])) {
      --ui-input-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }
  .ui-tag-input:focus-within {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-tag-input:has(.ui-tag-input-field[aria-invalid="true"]) { --ui-input-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-tag-input:has(.ui-tag-input-field[aria-invalid="true"]):focus-within {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-tag-input[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-tag-input[data-readonly] { --ui-input-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-muted) 60%, transparent); }

  /* The text field: borderless, takes the space left on the row */
  .ui-tag-input-field {
    flex: 1 1 6rem;
    min-width: 6rem;
    height: var(--ui-tag-h);
    padding: 0 0.375rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    outline: none;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-tag-input-field::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-tag-input-field:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* Chips are secondary Badges */
  .ui-tag {
    flex-shrink: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: 100%;
    cursor: default;
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-tag:has(.ui-badge-remove) { padding-inline-end: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-tag-label { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  /* The next Backspace removes this one */
  .ui-tag[data-highlighted] {
    background-color: var(--ui-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 60%, transparent);
  }
  /* A duplicate was refused: the existing chip shakes */
  .ui-tag[data-shake] { animation: ui-tag-shake 360ms var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-tag-input[data-disabled] .ui-badge-remove { pointer-events: none; }

  /* Suggestions */
  .ui-tag-listbox {
    max-height: 14rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-tag-listbox[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-tag-listbox[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-tag-option {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .ui-tag-option[data-highlighted] { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }

  /* Live region for screen readers */
  .ui-tag-input-status {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  /* iOS Safari zooms the page when a focused field is under 16px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-tag-input,
    .ui-tag-input-field { font-size: 1rem; }
  }
}

@keyframes ui-tag-shake {
  0% { transform: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 55%, transparent); }
  20% { transform: translateX(-4px); }
  40% { transform: translateX(4px); }
  60% { transform: translateX(-3px); }
  80% { transform: translateX(2px); }
  100% { transform: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px transparent; }
}
```

## Usage

**Email recipients** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/tag-input/recipients.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { TagInput } from '@/ui/components/tag-input';

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export default function TagInputRecipients() {
  const [recipients, setRecipients] = useState<string[]>(['ada@northwind.com', 'grace@northwind.com']);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <Field>
        <Label>Send the invoice to</Label>
        <TagInput
          value={recipients}
          onValueChange={setRecipients}
          maxTags={5}
          validate={(tag) => EMAIL.test(tag) || `${tag} is not a valid email address`}
          placeholder="name@company.com"
          inputMode="email"
          name="recipients"
        />
        <FieldHint>Press Enter, comma or Tab to add. Paste a list to add several. {recipients.length} of 5 added.</FieldHint>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```
